paper_title: Extended Search for the Invisible Axion with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: 90% confidence exclusion limit extracted from Figure 4 of the paper. The limit is nearly flat across the measured mass range, set to 8.56×10^−15 GeV^−1. Coverage spans 2.81–3.31 µeV with a gap around 3.09–3.14 µeV (largest mode crossing at 753.844 MHz). Uses Maxwell-Boltzmann dark matter halo model as primary (darker green in figure); N-body results nearly identical. Assumed dark matter density: ρa = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Limited sensitivity at five additional mode crossings listed in Table I (smaller gaps not resolved in extraction). For DFSZ benchmark model (g=0.36), the reported couplings exclude 100% of dark matter hypothesis in this mass range.
